question: Which amongst the following statements about the Indian social reformers of the 19th century is INCORRECT?

options.text: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar was the founder of the Brahmo Samaj.
The Aligarh Movement was started by Sir Syed Ahmad Khan in 1875.
Mahadev Govind Ranade is associated with the Poona Sarvajanik Sabha
Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar was the founder of the Brahmo Samaj**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar** was not the founder of the Brahmo Samaj. The Brahmo Samaj was founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** in 1828.
 
• The **Aligarh Movement** was indeed started by **Sir Syed Ahmad Khan** in 1875 to promote modern education among Muslims.
 
• **Mahadev Govind Ranade** is correctly associated with the **Poona Sarvajanik Sabha**, an organization aimed at promoting social and political reforms.
 
• **Dayanand Saraswati** founded the **Arya Samaj** in 1875, advocating for a return to the teachings of the Vedas and promoting social reform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar** was a prominent social reformer known for his efforts in promoting education and widow remarriage.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj played a crucial role in modernizing Indian society and promoting rational thinking and social reforms.
 
• The **Aligarh Movement** led to the establishment of the **Mohammedan Anglo-Oriental College**, which later became the **Aligarh Muslim University**.
 
• **Mahadev Govind Ranade** was also a judge and one of the founding members of the Indian National Congress.
 
• The **Arya Samaj** had a significant influence on Indian society, promoting values such as equality, social justice, and the importance of education.
